extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting e-print papers (preprints) to the arXiv repository, including allowed formats, figure requirements, scheduling, replacement rules, and author responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered authors only
rubrics_metrics.description: We only accept submissions from registered authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must be registered before submitting; registrations are required for all submitters.

rubrics_metrics.name: No omitted figures/tables/sections or abstract-only submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that we do not accept submissions with omitted figures, tables or sections. We also do not accept 'abstract only' submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such submissions are unhelpful to readers and of very limited archival value; include all figures/tables/sections in the submission itself (not via external links).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted text formats (order of preference)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your submission to the archive must be in one of the following formats (listed in order of preference): (La)TeX/AMS(La)TeX, PDF, PostScript, HTML with JPEG/GIF/PNG images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ArXiv's goal is to store papers in formats which are highly portable and stable; TeX/LaTeX is preferred because the open format does not hide information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restrictions on TeX-derived files
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that for this and other reasons we will not accept dvi, PS, or PDF created from TeX/LaTeX source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you use TeX/LaTeX, submit the source (La)TeX/AMS(La)TeX rather than generated DVI/PS/PDF files produced from it.

rubrics_metrics.name: No scanned documents accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Note also that we will not accept scanned documents, regardless of format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit scans of printed pages; provide source or proper electronic formats instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formats for figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Figures for a submission can be in a number of common formats. These include: PostScript (PS/EPS, most common for line drawings, plots, etc.), JPEG (ideal for photographic images), GIF or PNG (best for non-photographic images, bitmaps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If figure files are too large, readers with poor network connections will not be able to download them. Reduce size where possible. Do not omit figures and provide only links to another server—such submissions are not accepted. See arXiv information on submission sizes and bitmapping help for more details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figure size and bandwidth considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: If figure files are too large, then readers with poor network connections will not be able to download them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your submission has a large figure, be sure to include it, but make all possible efforts to reduce its size. Consult submission-size guidance and bitmapping help; contact www-admin@arXiv.org for problems with large submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Including figures in TeX source
rubrics_metrics.description: If you submit figures with your (La)TeX source, use standard macro packages (e.g., the graphics and graphicx packages) so that the figures will appear in the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standard, widely-supported packages to ensure figures render correctly in arXiv's processing pipeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: No TeX support from arXiv administration
rubrics_metrics.description: Unfortunately, arXiv administration cannot provide help with TeX-related issues, so seek help from your colleagues if necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan to resolve TeX problems locally or with collaborators; do not rely on arXiv staff for TeX troubleshooting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read response and check your submission
rubrics_metrics.description: After you submit your paper, you will receive a response from arXiv. It is very important that you read this response. Be sure to check for errors in the copy of the abstract that appears in the message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The response to a successful submission will include a URL that will allow you to view the PostScript version generated here, together with a username/password for viewing it. If you see any errors or are unhappy with the formatting, replace the paper to correct problems or email www-admin@arXiv.org explaining the problem before 16:00 US Eastern time. Do not send files/submissions to that address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement policy for corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage authors to update and to make corrections in their papers. DO NOT make a new submission for a corrected paper or for an erratum. Rather replace the original submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you replace before 16:00 US Eastern time Monday through Friday, the archive software will not generate an additional date stamp (which some authors find desirable). Follow the replacement process rather than submitting a new paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission availability schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: All archives are on a daily availability schedule, with no activity scheduled on weekends. Each day's submissions are not made available to the general public until 20:00 US Eastern time (EDT/EST) Sunday through Thursday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided: a Monday submission before 16:00 appears after 20:00 that day; a Friday submission before 16:00 appears after 20:00 of the following Sunday; a Friday submission after 16:00 appears after 20:00 of the following Monday. Check current local time at the main site for exact scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author must submit themselves; avoid third-party submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Because putting papers on the archives entails certain responsibilities, authors must make their own submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Third-party submissions (by secretaries for example) are often the ones that cause the most problems, presumably due to lack of self-interest and related factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required metadata: affiliations and report numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: The following information is also required for submission: Institutional affiliation for the author(s) must be provided. Official report number(s) from the author(s) institution(s) must be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all required metadata fields (affiliations, report numbers) are filled in at submission to avoid processing issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for large-submission problems
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have problems with a large submission, contact us at www-admin@arXiv.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send files to the address; use it to explain problems and seek administrative guidance about submission size issues.
